set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# The managed Ubuntu 16.04 image advertises ESM repositories, but this
# disposable task has no ESM credentials. Disable those entries everywhere;
# the public Xenial repositories carry the MariaDB packages and dependencies.
for apt_source in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*; do
  if [ -f "$apt_source" ]; then
    if grep -q 'esm\.ubuntu\.com' "$apt_source"; then
      case "$apt_source" in
        /etc/apt/sources.list)
          sudo -n sed -i \
            '/esm\.ubuntu\.com/s/^/# disabled for InfraSet task: /' \
            "$apt_source"
          ;;
        *)
          sudo -n mv "$apt_source" "$apt_source.disabled"
          ;;
      esac
    fi
  fi
done
sudo -n find /var/lib/apt/lists -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*esm*' -delete
sudo -n apt-get \
  -o Acquire::Retries=1 \
  -o Acquire::http::Timeout=20 \
  -o Acquire::https::Timeout=20 \
  update
sudo -n apt-get install -y mariadb-server mariadb-client
sudo -n systemctl enable --now mysql
sudo -n systemctl is-active mysql

set -eu
sudo -n mysql <<'SQL'
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS legacy_shop;
USE legacy_shop;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  external_ref VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  full_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('active','paused','closed') NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (customer_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_customers_external_ref (external_ref),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_customers_email (email)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  order_ref VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  total_cents INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending','paid','shipped','cancelled') NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_orders_ref (order_ref),
  KEY ix_orders_customer_created (customer_id, created_at),
  CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (customer_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
  order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  line_no SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  quantity SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, line_no),
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
  event_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  entity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  event_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  details VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (event_id),
  KEY ix_audit_entity (entity_type, entity_id, event_time)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

DELETE FROM audit_events;
DELETE FROM order_items;
DELETE FROM orders;
DELETE FROM customers;
